player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Acïn kë cï yök ke ye dhöl path. Loi '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Leek {player_id}, kɔ̈ɔ̈u ku aye kɔ̈ɔ̈u. Kɔlɔ̈m {col} ee ciɛɛm ku.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Aye kɔ̈ɔ̈u ku {quantity} ku thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ {pile_index} (ku {pile_count} ciɛɛm ku).

observation.removed_from_piles: Leek {player_id} kɔ̈ɔ̈u ku [{pile_index} {quantity}], kɔ̈ɔ̈u ku {quantity} dhiɛ̈ɛ̈l ku thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acï kë cï döŋ nyaai!
